Final Fantasy III.name: Final Fantasy III
Final Fantasy III.summary: The PlayStation Portable version of Final Fantasy III 3D Remake features upgraded resolution for the PSP screen, optimized loading times and traditional button controls. While the content remains unchanged, the PSP release offers a smoother experience on handheld hardware with a more classic feel.

Free Running.name: Free Running
Free Running.summary: The whole ethos of Free Running (an urban environment sport also known as Parkour) is to be free, break boundaries, go where others dare not. In this game, the world around you becomes your playground -- where others walk, you jump; where others stop, you climb; where others stall, you leap to victory!

Idolm@ster SP, The - Missing Moon.name: The Idolmaster: SP - Missing Moon
Idolm@ster SP, The - Missing Moon.summary:
The Idolmaster SP is a series of three Japanese raising simulation video games in The Idolmaster game series. They were released on as Perfect Sun, Missing Moon, and Wandering Star for the PlayStation Portable as a port of The Idolmaster.

The games include three game modes: two single-player and one multiplayer mode for up to three players. The story is told from the perspective of a producer in charge of training 10 prospective pop idols on their way to stardom, and each version of SP features different idols.

Lucky Star - Net Idol Meister.name: Lucky Star: Net Idol Meister
Lucky Star - Net Idol Meister.summary: Lucky Star: Net Idol Meister is an idol-management simulator in which you must train and turn one of the Lucky Star girls into the biggest net idol.

Yggdra Union.name: Yggdra Union: We'll Never Fight Alone
Yggdra Union.summary:
Yggdra Union was remade/enhanced for the PSP with redrawn graphics, voice acting, some new characters, new/edited maps and an increase to 8 units brought into battles instead of the original limit of 6.

"Yggdra Union tells the story of a princess ousted from her country and her mission to win it back from the Imperial Army.

From a bandit king to a valiant knight, to a young Undine girl, Yggdra is joined in her mission by an ever-increasing band of rag-tag adventurers. Each of them has his or her own beliefs and ambitions, but as thier paths cross, they soon find that protecting what they love most means somehow finding a way to stop the Empire.

Get ready for one of the most unique and engrossing straegy games ever to hit the PSP!"
